---
description: "Clarify product needs and write approved, testable requirements."
agent: requirements-analyst
argument-hint: "Describe the documentation sync tool and any known users or constraints."
---
Use the request and [README.md](../../README.md) as input. Ask concise questions about unresolved goals, users, sources, outputs, and constraints before drafting.

Write [requirements.md](../../docs/requirements.md) with goals, non-goals, use cases, constraints, and testable acceptance criteria. Mark unknown facts `Not Found`. Stop for human approval before architecture.
